name: Murder Mystery X
seoDescription: Discover active Murder Mystery X codes to unlock unique knives and weapons that add style to your Roblox matches without affecting gameplay.
introMd: Murder Mystery X is a Roblox game where players get to enjoy a mix of suspense and style. Codes in the game unlock unique knives and weapons that don’t change gameplay but let you stand out while playing. These codes are a neat way to grab cool items without spending Robux, and knowing how to use them can add a fresh look to your matches. If you want to keep your inventory looking sharp, checking for new Murder Mystery X codes is a smart move.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Murder Mystery X Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes in Murder Mystery X. Just follow these steps to get your free knives and weapons:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Murder Mystery X]].
2. Open the shop menu inside the game.
3. Look for the code entry box at the top of the shop menu.
4. Type or paste the code exactly as it appears.
5. Press enter to redeem your reward.
Make sure to enter codes carefully since they are case sensitive.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Redeeming codes in Murder Mystery X usually gives you exclusive knives and weapons. These items are purely cosmetic but highly sought after for their unique designs that help you customize your look in the game.

| Reward Type       | Description                                   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Knives            | Special knives with unique skins to equip.   |
| Weapons           | Various weapons with distinct appearances.    |
| Pets (rare)       | Occasionally, pets like the Ice Dragon appear as rewards. |

These rewards do not affect gameplay but add style and variety to your inventory, making your character stand out during matches.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if they are entered incorrectly since Murder Mystery X codes are case sensitive. Double-check the spelling and capitalization before redeeming. Also, expired codes will no longer work, so always use the latest active codes. If you still have issues, restarting the game and trying again can help.
